[EN] I won't give up hope. Look at all these people working to bring back life. Real life, not argon life.
[ES] No perderé la esperanza. Mira a toda esta gente trabajando para devolverle la vida. Vida real, no vida de los argons.

[EN] I don't know how you're going to feel about this... But I think we're the only surviving faeries in this region.
[ES] No sé cómo vas a sentirte al respecto... Pero creo que somos las únicas hadas que quedan en esta región.

[EN] This used to be a nice neighborhood... Until those monsters turned up from who-knows-where!
[ES] Este solía ser un vecindario agradable... ¡Hasta que aparecieron esos monstruos de quién sabe dónde!

[EN] They're called argons, right? They attach themselves to the creatures here and become a part of them.

That's why the bears attacked people. Normally they wouldn't.
[ES] Se llaman argons, ¿verdad? Se adhieren a las criaturas de aquí y se vuelven parte de ellas.

Por eso los osos atacaron a la gente. Normalmente no lo harían.

[EN] I really don't know. Cheniel still wants to go through with the restoration... But could we really live here again even after it's restored?
[ES] La verdad no lo sé. Cheniel todavía quiere seguir adelante con la restauración... ¿Pero de verdad podríamos volver a vivir aquí incluso después de que sea restaurado?
